title: Beacon Lead Scorer
tagline: Score a B2B lead 1-10 from live public web data.
problem: Manual lead research is slow and usually depends on paid APIs before a lead is even worth a look.
solution: Built a Next.js app that researches a company through keyless public sources and returns a scored report with reasoning and sources, plus a deterministic fallback.

visual.alt: Beacon live demo shown at desktop, tablet and mobile widths with the company report form.
visual.label: LIVE DEMO · DEVICE CAPTURES

title: RetailNova Enterprise Analytics
tagline: SQL and Power BI analytics for a multi-channel retailer.
problem: Retail operations needed profitability, returns and logistics signals in one decision view.
solution: Built MySQL and Python cleaning/EDA over STAGED CSV datasets, plus Power BI executive dashboards.

visual.alt: RetailNova Power BI executive dashboard from the project repository; dataset rows are STAGED.
visual.label: REPO CAPTURE · STAGED DATA

title: Phishing Detector
tagline: Chrome extension that checks a page against a Django API.
problem: Users cannot quickly tell whether the page in front of them is legitimate or a phishing site.
solution: Built a Chrome popup that sends the current URL to a hosted Django REST endpoint and shows a safe or phishing verdict.
impact: Live public demo — enter a URL

title: Autonomous Revenue Engine
tagline: Scheduled worker with approval gates for bounty scans and bid drafts.
problem: Finding and qualifying freelance work stalls as soon as the laptop closes, and paid APIs or proxies add cost before any return.
solution: Built a worker with Ollama triage, Apify data, systemd timers, Telegram digests and hard spend guardrails; a human sends every bid.

title: Apify Data Extraction Actor
tagline: Production scraper actor with buyer-safe defaults.
problem: Extracting clean lead data for buyers needs a hosted actor that is safe to run and predictable in output.
solution: Built and tested a private Apify actor with a versioned build and deterministic result shape.

title: OpenCode Worker
tagline: Headless coding agent controlled through a small HTTP API.
problem: Long-running coding tasks need a worker that survives a closed laptop and stays reachable for a remote manager.
solution: Ran an OpenCode server as a systemd service behind the v1 HTTP API with a Cloudflare tunnel and SSH-tunneled manager access.

title: AI Client Portal
tagline: A client portal for briefs, approvals and delivery status.
problem: Client work gets scattered across chats, docs and ad-hoc status updates.
solution: Building one portal where clients can submit briefs, review milestones and track delivery in a single place.

title: Automation Dashboard
tagline: One dashboard for worker jobs, spend and alerts.
problem: Background automation is hard to trust without a clear view of jobs, costs and failures.
solution: Building a dashboard that surfaces worker runs, credit guardrails and Telegram alerts in one place.
